pillar_reactions.evidence: The rep announced a presentation at 00:38:04 — 'Let's do this, dude. I'm going to walk you through Trevor's coaching. I'm to break it down for you' — and then never delivered it. The only programme content in 67 minutes was a scheduling sketch offered much earlier at 00:14:32 ('in the other three days, we just fit a kettlebell workout in that 30 to 45 minutes'), which the prospect liked, plus generic claims that kettlebells force the body to move as a unit. No pillar was named or run.

Never delivered. Diet was covered thoroughly in baseline — full day of eating, the night-time trail mix, ice cream and cereal — and identified by both parties as the binding constraint, but no nutrition method, principle or structure was ever presented as part of the offer.

Never delivered as a pillar, though the concept was used as a qualification test rather than a feature: 'if you can't even be accountable to yourself and what you know is best, like how the [hell] are you supposed to be accountable to Trevor?' The prospect's own objection — 'in three months, I probably won't even need you guys' — was the precise opening for this pillar and it was answered with an argument about his track record instead of with the mechanism.

anchors.raw: I do have access to the YMCA, which like they'll watch your kids while you exercise, which is basically my, my saving grace
anchors.note: He already has a facility, childcare and a routine he is broadly satisfied with, at membership cost. The rep noticed the strength of the incumbent and said so out loud — '45 minutes, a couple times a week, mean, that's pretty efficient already, right? Like, why make a shift?' — which is honest qualification but also hands the prospect the argument. No unit cost was ever established, so nothing was in place to make $6,000 land against it.

anchors.raw: If I do commit to a change, I do make a change, commit to it, in three months, I probably won't even need you guys.
anchors.note: The most consequential anchor on the call. His comparison point is not a cheaper provider but free self-direction, and he is credible — he already trains five to six times a week and races. The rep rebutted from track record and got a concession, but the anchor was never replaced with a reason the coaching is worth paying for, because the offer was never presented.

anchors.raw: I probably should be medicated. I would like to avoid it because I like, I don't like, I don't want to be on the statin. Uh, I've heard it affects your muscles, you know, your training. I don't want that. So I'm trying to do as much as I can before, uh, having to go on a statin. This is, I guess, part of that quest.
anchors.note: The one anchor pointing toward a purchase. He has framed lifestyle change as the alternative to medication he does not want, which gives the programme a concrete job and a deadline. The rep leaned on it hard as a consequence, which works commercially but means the prospect's motivation to buy is partly a motivation to avoid clinically indicated treatment. Worth watching as a pattern across the corpus rather than treating as a clean buying signal.

unmet_demand.want: Structured kettlebell programming and specific skill acquisition — the flows and named lifts — layered onto his existing endurance training at two to three sessions a week
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This is what he actually asked for in his opening answer and it is almost certainly inside the offer, but the rep treated the modest scope as a disqualifier — 'if it's just like, well, hey, I want to learn a couple workouts, like, you know, doing pretty in-depth coaching with him is probably not going to make sense' — and then spent the call on behaviour change instead. Nobody ever told him the programme does the thing he came for.

unmet_demand.want: Training that protects and complements six months a year of ocean-swim race preparation
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep repeatedly steered toward migrating endurance work into kettlebells — 'a lot of them are like, man, I kind of just migrated a lot of my workout and my exercise to, specifically, kettlebells' — before conceding an integration model. Whether the programme can be periodised around a three-mile race was never established.

unmet_demand.want: Help with the cannabis dependence and the resulting night eating, which both parties identified as the actual blocker to every stated goal
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The offer is kettlebell training, nutrition and accountability. It has no clinical or substance-use component, and no clinician is involved. The rep nonetheless took the work on personally during the call, which delivered the intervention without any of the competence or aftercare that would make it safe.

unmet_demand.want: Someone in his life who tells him the truth directly and keeps doing so
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He named this himself — 'you have done a good job of telling me the hard truth that I've known but haven't been told by anyone else' — and it is the clearest thing he valued in 67 minutes. The accountability pillar plausibly serves it, but it was never presented, so the demand was created and left unattached to anything purchasable.
